The Gateway Pundit is a far-right news and opinion website founded by Jim Hoft in 2004. Known for its provocative content and strong conservative leanings, the site has garnered significant attention and controversy over the years. Frequently criticized for publishing misleading and false information, the Gateway Pundit has been involved in spreading numerous conspiracy theories.

One of the most notable controversies associated with the platform was its promotion of debunked claims about election fraud in the 2020 United States presidential election. The Gateway Pundit also perpetuated misinformation regarding the COVID-19 pandemic, including false narratives about the virus's origins and the effectiveness of vaccines.

The website has connections with various controversial figures, including Alex Jones, a prominent conspiracy theorist. Although there is no formal partnership, both have shared similar narratives and misinformation, reinforcing each other's far-right agendas and conspiracy theories.

Despite these controversies, the Gateway Pundit continues to maintain a significant audience, illustrating the impact and reach of alternative media sources in contemporary political discourse. Its role in shaping narratives on the far-right has made it a focal point in discussions about media responsibility and the spread of misinformation.
